questions.q: What are the three layers of the Lambda architecture?
options: Speed layer, batch layer, and serving layer
Bronze, silver, and gold
Ingestion, transformation, and governance
OLTP, OLAP, and object storage
questions.explain: The speed and batch layers run in parallel, and the serving layer merges both into one presented answer.

questions.q: In the taxi platform mapping, what plays the role of the speed layer?
options: RawTripEvents streaming into a KQL Database with windowed dashboards
A nightly Databricks job reprocessing the full day's trips
A Power BI report combining both layers
The vendor's OLTP booking system
questions.explain: The batch layer is the nightly Databricks medallion reprocessing job; the serving layer is what combines both.

questions.q: What is the real cost of the Lambda architecture, according to this lesson?
options: Maintaining two separate implementations of the same business logic, in two different engines, which can quietly drift apart and produce discrepancies
It requires twice as much storage as any other architecture
It cannot be implemented using any tool taught in this track
There is no real cost — Lambda is strictly better than any single-layer design
questions.explain: If the KQL aggregation and PySpark aggregation logic ever diverge even slightly, the dashboard shows a discrepancy unrelated to the actual data.

questions.q: Why might a team still choose Lambda despite the codepath-drift risk?
options: The speed layer's fast approximate answer and the batch layer's slow exact answer sometimes serve genuinely different purposes worth the cost of maintaining two codepaths
Lambda architecture has no real downside once implemented correctly
Codepath drift is not actually possible in a well-designed Lambda system
Lambda is always cheaper to build than a single-layer batch or streaming design
questions.explain: A dispatcher needing "roughly now" and a billing reconciliation needing "exactly right" are different enough needs to justify the cost.

questions.q: How does Lambda architecture relate to Lesson 5's hybrid processing model?
options: Lambda gives Lesson 5's hybrid idea a specific, named shape — a speed layer and batch layer running in parallel, feeding a serving layer
Lambda architecture is a completely different concept unrelated to hybrid processing
Lambda architecture replaces the need for a hybrid processing model entirely
Lambda architecture only applies to batch processing, never hybrid designs
questions.explain: Every piece of the Lambda mapping is a tool this track already taught in isolation, now coordinated as one design.
